name: Bait
description: Bait makes fish bite sooner or luckier; one is used per fish.

pages.title: Bait
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Bait goes **inside** the rod: hold the bait on your cursor and right-click the rod.
- Each fish caught uses one bait from every slot.
- Plain **Bait** and **Worms** make fish bite sooner; **Lucky Bait** brings rarer catches.

In your inventory, pick up a bait stack and right-click the rod with it. Right-click the rod with an empty cursor to take bait back out.\
\
Each bait slot holds one kind of bait (a whole stack). A rod with two slots can carry two different baits, and both work.

Bait is used only when you land a **fish**: junk, treasure, crates and misses cost nothing.

- **Bait**: bites much sooner.
- **Worm**: bites sooner.
- **Lucky Bait**: more luck.
- **Magnetic Bait**: crates five times as often.
A crop, mushroom or small flower, rotten flesh, seeds and bone meal make 4 Bait.

pages.title: Worm Farm
pages.text: Aquaculture's Worm Farm still makes **Worms**, and they work as bait in Tide rods. Feed it compostable scraps.

- **Lucky Bait**: 8 Bait around a rabbit's foot make 16.
- **Magnetic Bait**: lapis, 2 Bait, redstone, iron nuggets and prismarine make 4.
- **Incandescent** and **Abyss Bait** come from void fish and make bites sooner.
- Naturalist's **Butterflies** and **Caterpillars**, caught with a Capture Net, work like worms.
